## PR Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows PEP8 style guidelines
- [ ] All function signatures have type hints
- [ ] Inline comments explain the *why*, not just the *what*
- [ ] No hardcoded paths or API keys anywhere in the code

### Tests
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated for all changed modules
- [ ] All existing tests still pass (`python -m pytest tests/ -v`)

### Environment
- [ ] `.env.example` updated if new environment variables were added
- [ ] No `.env` file or secrets committed

### Git
- [ ] PR targets `develop`, not `main`
- [ ] Branch was rebased on latest `develop` before opening this PR
- [ ] Commit messages follow the Conventional Commits format
